description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 3 (Landscape Scheme) of planning permission ref. 23149/APP/2025/1793, dated 21-08-25 (Conversion of single dwelling house into 2 self-contained flats involving the erection of single-storey rear extension, conversion of roof space including rear dormer and front rooflights, amendments to fenestration and associated parking and landscaping.)
decision_conditions: The submitted landscaping plan fails to provide any detail in respect of the soft and hard landscaping in line with the requirements of Condition 3, including types of species and a planting schedule as well as details of landscape maintenance and implementation a design/specification for the refuse storage, means of enclosure, cycle storage or external lighting, all of which are required to ensure that these are appropriate in design and visual terms. It has not therefore been demonstrated that the development will preserve and enhance the visual amenities of the locality and provide adequate facilities in compliance with policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHB 14, DMEI 1 and DMT 2, DMT 5 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020) and Policy G5 and T6 of the London Plan (2021).
